items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: And Johnny has told you, I'm sure if you've interviewed him, about this little drummer. I believe his name was Zeno.

ctx.x: You mentioned Mrs. Lewis's dancing school.

Well, actually, it was a place that everybody went. There were some that signed up to go to these dances over a period, but you could get in for a dollar on a Saturday night. It was actually a dance more than it was a dancing school. And at that time, a lot of the boys and girls would just go there because there was no dance going on, no script dance up at Tulane. And instantly, I want to come back to Tulane again. I remember what the Oliver Band was paid. They were paid $28 for seven men, but you had to…
Is that his name? One time it was a happy bowl.
